footer_disclaimer_short: Securities and algorithmic trading involve substantial risk.
tagline_auto_trade: Design an engine and watchlist, run a signal, then loop on paper or live.
tagline_backtest: Walk-forward SMA, buy-the-dip, long/short pair, or Regime Dual Momentum on past bars — same presets as Auto Trade, no orders.
tagline_manual_order: Size a ticket by risk budget, dollars, or shares — the desk attaches the stop and the target for you.
tagline_positions: Inspect active holdings, track unrealized gains, and manage partial or full liquidations.
tagline_history: Filter Alpaca fills and desk sessions, with account and FIFO realized P&L by range.
tagline_api_keys: Connect Alpaca paper keys and AI providers. Strategy controls live on Auto Trade.
strategy_intro: Pick an engine, set the symbols to evaluate, then Run once. Buy/sell signals place paper or live orders.
reason_initial: Configure the strategy, then Run once to see a signal.
day_preset_hint: Intraday VWAP trend & 9/21 EMA momentum filtered by real-time AI news sentiment & macro catalyst confirmation.
day_ai_confirm_desc: Validates intraday breakout & momentum triggers with real-time news sentiment and macroeconomic calendar to veto false breakouts and traps.
eod_auto_flatten_desc: Automatically squares off all day trading positions before market close (zero overnight gap risk).
day_hint: Intraday algorithm calculates VWAP & Opening Range with optional AI confirmation. Positions are sized dynamically and auto-flattened before closing bell.
day_preset_summary_ai_vwap_momentum: Intraday VWAP trend & 9/21 EMA momentum filtered by real-time AI news sentiment & macro catalyst confirmation.
day_preset_summary_ai_orb_breakout: 15-minute Opening Range Breakout, volume-confirmed, with AI false-breakout veto and volatility expansion detection.
day_preset_summary_ai_adaptive_scalp: Fast 9/21 EMA momentum scalper with ADX regime filter and AI veto on counter-trend and chop setups.
day_preset_summary_vwap_trend: Trend following above intraday VWAP with 9/21 EMA momentum and 2R profit target.
day_preset_summary_orb_breakout: Trades volume-confirmed 15-minute opening range high breakouts with ATR trailing stop.
day_preset_summary_momentum_scalp: Fast 9/21 EMA crossovers confirmed by RSI > 55 and an ADX trend filter for quick scalps.
day_preset_summary_vwap_fade: Buys confirmed oversold bounces at the lower VWAP band in range-bound sessions only, targeting the VWAP midline.
day_preset_summary_custom: Tune your own intraday EMA, VWAP, ORB, AI confirmation, and EOD square-off rules.
engine_side_note_day_long: Intraday trend & mean reversion entries; auto-flattened before market close.
engine_side_note_day_ls: Intraday long & short trading with automatic end-of-day square-off.
preset_hint: Hold when mixed; respect calendar; no chase.
symbol_hint: Quote and last signal on the wall. Add it to the evaluate list to trade it.
watchlist_hint: Each cycle evaluates this list. Featured is highlighted on the wall.
sma_hint: Fast must be smaller than Slow (e.g. 10 < 30).
dip_preset_hint: Buy RSI ≤30 or lower BB; exit RSI ≥60 or upper band.
skip_bearish_desc: Ignore dips when the SMA stack is bearish (fewer falling knives)
dip_hint: Deep / Mild also buy when price tags the lower Bollinger band; Washout requires RSI.
poll_hint: Loop checks the market every 20 seconds.
size_hint: Orders use share qty. Switch to dollars to size buys/sells in USD at the live mark.
risk_engine_help: Position size, stop distance, and the guards that stop a bad day compounding. Applies to AI, SMA, dip, and pair (LS has its own ATR fields). Edit any value to override a preset.
risk_engine_enabled_desc: Dynamic sizing, ATR stops, profit targets, and daily loss caps
risk_size_help: Size is set so a stop-out costs that % of equity. Stop distance scales with volatility via ATR × (0 turns ATR stops off).
size_hint_risk: Risk engine sizes shares so a stop-out costs that % of equity (desk qty/dollars are the fallback when risk % is 0).
manual_risk_help: Size trades automatically based on your risk budget and market volatility (ATR). Position size scales with volatility — more volatility = fewer shares. Stop distance is set to ATR × your multiplier. Example: $10k equity × 0.5% risk = $50 max loss per trade. If ATR is $2.89 and stop = 1.8×, each trade risks $50 on a 5.20 move.
help_risk_pct: Maximum loss per trade as a percentage of account equity. Range: 0.05–10%.
help_atr_mult: Stop distance multiplier. Wider multiples survive noise but buy fewer shares. Range: 0.1–10.
manual_risk_estimate: Sizes so a stop-out costs ~{pct}% of equity (needs ATR stop).
risk_rr_help: R is one unit of initial risk. Half the position is trimmed at the take-profit multiple (0 = never trim, let winners run). Past the trail multiple the stop moves to breakeven, then follows price.
risk_caps_help: New entries stop once either cap is reached. Exits and covers are never blocked. 0 turns a cap off.
risk_churn_help: Churn guards: a fresh position will not be flipped, a stopped-out symbol rests before re-entry, and wide spreads block new entries. The protective stop still works throughout.
options_overlay_help: Every strategy cycle also trades Alpaca options on the same view. Default is a defined-risk vertical (bull call on longs, bear put on shorts).
options_enabled_desc: Maps each SMA, dip, pair, LS, and AI signal onto Alpaca options
options_overlay_help_detail: 0 premium cap turns the budget check off. Overlay errors never block the equity engine.
ai_instructions_placeholder: Preset playbook loads here. Edit to switch to Custom.
ai_instructions_help: Sent to the model each cycle with TA, news, calendar, and earnings. Editing text switches the preset to Custom.
check_desc: Run once and Start loop place paper or live orders on buy/sell signals.
idle_state_hint: Idle — edit strategy, then run once.
backtest_intro: Walk-forward SMA, buy-the-dip, pair rotator, or Regime Dual Momentum on historical bars. Same presets as Auto Trade — no paper orders.
enter_symbol_hint: Enter a symbol to load mark and position.
err_alpaca_keys_required: Alpaca API credentials are not configured. Connect your API keys on API Keys to preview and size orders.
manual_loop_locked: Strategy loop is running — Advanced Order is locked.
tagline_backtest_history: Review saved backtest runs, open a result on Run, or select several to compare.
tagline_backtest_compare: Side-by-side metrics and equity overlay for the runs you selected on History.
size_hint_ai: The model picks shares each cycle from volatility, conviction, and liquidity — never above the risk-engine cap.
bt_mode_hint: Buy RSI ≤30 or lower BB; exit RSI ≥60 or upper band.
bt_pair_hint: Long leg by default; short leg only on confirmed bear impulses below SMA.
bt_ls_hint: Bull regime → long; bear regime → short. EMA + ADX filter, MACD hist trigger, ATR stops.
symbols_hint: Comma, space, or newline separated. Same strategy applies to each ticker.
multi_symbol_hint: Each symbol gets its own cash and equity curve for side-by-side comparison.
market_timeframe_hint: Daily bars support up to 2 years. Intraday is capped at 60 days.
qty_hint: Fixed share size on each buy signal.
slip_hint: Applied on each rotation leg. Pair backtest deploys full equity.
ls_size_hint: Position size from risk % ÷ ATR stop distance. Desk share qty is ignored. Frictions: 0.05% commission + slippage %.
stop_loss_buys_desc: Exit if price falls this % below entry (bar-low approximation)
by_symbol_hint: Select a row to focus the summary, chart, and trades.
chart_caption: Hover for date, equity, and price. Toggle series above.
saved_locally_help: Saved locally after each run. Select 2–4 runs, then open Compare.
compare_intro: Select 2–4 runs on History, then compare returns and equity curves here.
live_mode_desc: Real money — requires distinct live keys
live_keys_help: Use live keys from the Alpaca live dashboard — never reuse paper keys.
switch_to_live_confirm: Switch to Live trading? Any running loop will stop.
switch_to_paper_confirm: Switch back to Paper trading? Any running loop will stop.
clear_alpaca_confirm: Clear saved paper and live Alpaca keys from .env? You will need to paste them again to reconnect.
live_banner_authorized: LIVE TRADING — real money. Orders will reach the live account.
not_connected_keys: Not connected — paste paper and/or live keys below
loop_live_confirm: Starting the loop will place real orders on buy/sell signals. Continue?
loop_paper_confirm: Starting the loop will place paper orders on buy/sell signals. Continue?
active_ai_provider_desc: Select the single AI provider powering automated trade signals, market analysis, and written trade debriefs.
provider_anthropic_desc: Claude Sonnet / Opus / Haiku · High precision
ai_provider_pending: Showing {selected} credentials — the desk stays on {active} until you apply.
ai_provider_switched: {provider} is now the active AI provider.
save_key_env_desc: Checked writes to disk; unchecked keeps the key for this session only.
stop_loss_buys_attach: On buys, attach a protective sell below entry
manual_help_text: Market in regular hours; use Limit outside RTH. Protective stop applies to buys.
pnl_note: Account P&L is the move in account equity across the range. Realized P&L pairs buys→sells FIFO from fills in the range.
pair_hint: Enter two symbols in the watchlist (long first, short second). Daily bars; deploys available cash into the active leg.
market_hours_warn: Market orders are only available in regular hours — switch to Limit.
featured_warn_text: Featured symbol is not on the evaluate list.
title_test_history: Open Backtest with this watchlist (AI falls back to SMA)
engine_side_note_long: Sell closes a long — no short from flat.
mode_hint_sma: Classic crossover on the evaluate list — buy/sell when fast SMA crosses slow.
engine_side_note_ai: Can open a long or a short on each symbol from TA, news, calendar, and earnings.
engine_side_note_ls: Opens long in bull regimes and short in bear regimes on the same symbol.
engine_side_note_pair: Buys the long-leg or short-leg symbol — does not short-sell a stock.
engine_side_note_long_full: Buy opens a long. Sell closes it. Flat accounts stay flat on a sell.
mode_hint_ai: Model reads TA, news, earnings, and the calendar — then can go long or short on each evaluate-list symbol.
mode_hint_dip: Buys oversold washes (RSI or lower Bollinger); sells into RSI recovery or upper band.
mode_hint_pair: Rotates full cash between a long and short leg — long in bull regime, short only on crash impulses.
mode_hint_ls: Regime Dual Momentum (L/S): long in bull EMA/ADX; short in bear on MACD crosses; ATR stops.
mode_hint_day: Intraday execution using VWAP, Opening Range Breakout (ORB), EMA momentum, and automatic EOD flattening.
size_hint_pair: Pair mode deploys available cash into the active leg (desk size is only a fallback).
size_hint_ls: LS sizes by equity × risk% / ATR stop distance. Desk size is only a fallback if equity is unavailable.
size_hint_notional_zero: Enter a dollar amount greater than 0 to size orders in USD.
size_hint_notional_template: Orders size to about {amount} at the live mark (converted to shares each cycle).
featured_warn_template: {symbol} is featured on the wall but not on the evaluate list — it will not be traded.
err_rsi_order: RSI buy must be less than RSI sell before you can run.
err_sma_order: Fast must be smaller than Slow before you can run.
incomplete_pair: Incomplete pair — need both key and secret
not_connected_paste: Not connected — paste paper keys below
alpaca_missing_html: Alpaca: missing — set keys on API Keys
loop_running_stop_hint: Loop running · {elapsed} — Stop to edit strategy again.
stopping_waiting: Stopping… finishing the symbol in flight.
outside_rth_truncate: Outside RTH truncates to {qty} whole shares
not_enough_equity: Not enough equity points to overlay.
avg_across_symbols: Average across symbols (see table for each)
preset_summary_balanced: Hold when mixed; long or short when trend, momentum, and news align.
preset_summary_conservative: Rare, high-quality trades only; wide stop, small size, sits out risk events.
preset_summary_momentum: Follow strength — long uptrends, short breakdowns, let winners run.
preset_summary_mean_reversion: Fade stretched moves back to the mean; wide stop, quick target, time-limited.
preset_summary_news_aware: Trade fresh catalysts; wide stop for gap risk, flat when headlines are stale.
preset_summary_trend_atr: Pure trend following: no fixed target, ride the trail until it breaks.
preset_summary_pead: Trade the post-earnings drift after a surprise, in the direction of the print.
preset_summary_orb: Intraday: trade the break of the opening range, flat by the close.
sma_preset_summary_short_term: Faster crosses — more signals, more noise.
sma_preset_summary_fibonacci: Fib-friendly windows popular with swing traders.
sma_preset_summary_swing: Medium-term trend filter — fewer, cleaner crosses.
sma_preset_summary_golden_cross: Classic long-term golden/death cross on daily bars.
sma_preset_summary_custom: Set your own fast / slow windows below.
dip_preset_summary_deep: Buy RSI ≤30 or lower BB; exit RSI ≥60 or upper band.
dip_preset_summary_mild: Shallower dips — RSI ≤35 or lower BB; exit RSI ≥55 or upper band.
dip_preset_summary_washout: Capitulation only — RSI ≤25 (no BB-only entries); exit RSI ≥65 or upper band. Allows bearish trend.
dip_preset_summary_custom: Set your own RSI buy / sell thresholds below (also buys lower BB).
pair_preset_summary_research_max: Long leg above SMA50 by default; rotate to the short leg only on ≤−5% N-day drops while below SMA. Tuned on inverse ETF history.
pair_preset_summary_research_strict: Fewer short-leg flips — needs a sharper 7-day drop (≤−8%) below SMA50.
pair_preset_summary_cash_weak: Same impulse entry into the short leg, but sit in cash (not the long leg) when below SMA without a crash signal — lower time-in-market.
pair_preset_summary_custom: Set SMA, lookback, impulse %, and weak-side behavior below.
warn_rsi_threshold: RSI buy must be less than RSI sell before you can run.
warn_sma_window: Fast must be smaller than Slow before you can run.
alpaca_keys_incomplete: Incomplete pair — need both key and secret
alpaca_keys_not_connected: Not connected — paste paper keys below
loop_stopping: Stopping… finishing the symbol in flight.
manual_order_meta_init: Enter a symbol to load mark and position.
not_enough_equity_points: Not enough equity points to overlay.
alpha_avg_across_symbols: Average across symbols (see table for each)
placeholder_bt_symbols: AAPL, MSFT… — or long, short for pair

history_empty_desk: No desk orders in this range.

history_cap_note: Showing the {limit} most recent of {total} fills.
pnl_note_filtered: Account P&L is n/a when a symbol or side filter is set. Realized (FIFO) uses the full time range; filters apply to the fill list only.
pnl_note_capped: Showing the {limit} most recent fills in this range (max {limit}). Account P&L uses Alpaca portfolio history. Realized P&L is FIFO from those fills.
pnl_note_capped_short: Showing up to {limit} most recent fills in range.
pnl_note_connect: Connect Alpaca paper keys on Configuration to load fills and account P&L.
pnl_note_desk: Account P&L is the move in account equity for this range. Desk sessions below are local loop/once orders.
clear_desk_confirm:
Clear all desk session history? This cannot be undone.

Alpaca fills are unchanged.
history_session_empty: No orders submitted yet — waiting for a buy/sell fill.
export_empty: Nothing to export for the current filters.
custom_range_hint: Dates are whole market days, New York time.
custom_range_needs_date: Pick a start or end date first.
custom_range_inverted: The start date must come before the end date.
caveat_side_ignored: Side filter does not change realized P&L
warn_window_truncated: History could not finish loading this range. Some older fills and realized P&L may be missing — refresh or narrow the range and try again.
warn_opening_inventory: History could not read what this account held before the range ({error}), so P&L on fills that close an older position may be wrong.
warn_estimated_basis: Closed from a position opened before this range and since exited, so Alpaca has no entry price left to cost it against: {detail}
estimated_basis_title: This position was opened before the range, so its cost basis comes from Alpaca's average entry price.
history_no_match_hint: Clear the symbol or side filter to see the whole range.
history_no_match_desk: No desk orders match these filters.
export_csv_title: Download the rows shown as CSV.
export_nothing_title: Nothing to export for the current filters.
reset_filters_title: Back to the default month view.
clear_desk_alpaca_title: Switch Source to Desk sessions to clear local desk history.
partial_fill_title: One execution of an order that filled in several pieces.
realized_by_strategy_help: P&L is credited to the Auto Trade mode and preset that opened the position.
exit_strategy_hint: Configure Stop Loss, Breakeven, Trailing Stop, or Profit Target
stop_loss_desc: Replaces existing protective stops with a GTC Stop order at this price level.
move_to_breakeven_desc: Moves your protective stop to average entry price so you cannot lose capital if the market reverses.
trailing_stop_desc: Trails peak market price dynamically to let winning positions run while locking in profits.
take_profit_desc: Submits a GTC Limit exit order to sell (for Long) or cover (for Short) at target price.
clear_exits_desc: Cancel active stop loss and/or take profit orders. Your shares will remain open but unprotected.
err_invalid_stop_price: Enter a valid stop price greater than 0
err_stop_above_market: Stop loss for a long position must sit below current price (${price})
err_stop_below_market: Stop loss for a short position must sit above current price (${price})
err_invalid_trail_pct: Enter a valid trail percentage between 0.1% and 50%
err_invalid_target_price: Enter a valid take profit price greater than 0
err_target_below_market: Take profit for a long position must sit above current price (${price})
err_target_above_market: Take profit for a short position must sit below current price (${price})
err_bracket_needs_levels: Enter at least a stop loss or take profit price
err_select_cancellation: Select at least one order type to cancel
manual_confirm_close_position: Close {qty} shares of {symbol} at market? Any resting protective stop is cancelled first.
confirm_close_all_desc: This will submit market orders to close all open positions immediately.
no_open_positions_desc: You currently have no open holdings. Start a strategy loop or place an advanced order to open positions.
keys_saved_verify: Keys saved · {mode} — refresh account to verify
env_pending_live: Showing Live credentials — the desk stays on Paper until you apply.
env_pending_paper: Showing Paper credentials — the desk stays on Live until you apply.
confirm_close_selected_desc: This will submit market orders to close the selected positions immediately.
cancel_resting_orders_desc: Also cancel any active stop loss or limit orders for these symbols.
pos_no_match_hint: No holding matches the current search, side, or status filter.
pos_open_orders_hint: Resting orders can hold shares back from a close
pos_loop_locked: Auto Trade is running — manual closes are locked so the strategy and your clicks cannot fight over the same position. Stop the loop to close manually.
pos_loop_locked_short: Stop the Auto Trade loop to close manually
pos_whole_shares_hint: Percentage selection rounded down to whole shares.
pos_qty_held_hint: Only {qty} shares are free; resting orders hold the rest. Keep 'Cancel resting open orders' on.
cancel_resting_orders_partial_desc: Cancels the stop on the remaining shares too — re-arm protection afterwards.
pos_liquidate_partial: {ok} submitted, {failed} failed — check the remaining rows
position_close_not_accepted: Close order was not accepted ({status}). Refresh the position and try again.
watch_px_stale: Price when the signal was taken
pos_lots_hint: See the individual share lots behind this holding
pos_lots_desc: Each parcel is an entry fill that no exit has retired yet, matched first-in first-out. The blended average hides which shares are actually in profit.
pos_lots_empty: No entry fills for this symbol inside the lookback window.
pos_lots_error: Could not rebuild the share lots
pos_lots_carried_hint: Opened before the lookback window — priced at the blended average entry.
pos_lots_carried_note: {qty} shares were bought before the {days}-day lookback; they are shown as one lot at the blended average entry.
pos_lots_truncated_note: Alpaca returned a full page of orders — older fills may be missing.
pos_lots_confirm_desc: This will submit a market order to liquidate {qty} shares.
pos_lots_confirm_fifo_note: Broker executes partial exits First-In, First-Out (FIFO). Oldest parcels are retired first.
confirm_no_estimate: The desk will size this ticket on submit — the numbers above are incomplete.
confirm_qty_clamped: Sell qty will be clamped to your position: {from} → {to} (held {held}).
confirm_qty_truncated: Outside regular hours, qty truncates to whole shares: {from} → {to}.

err_limit_price: Limit price must be greater than $0.00.
err_no_equity: Account equity is unavailable — connect Alpaca on API Keys before sizing a ticket.
err_no_stop_distance: No ATR for this symbol and no flat stop % set on Auto Trade — the risk engine cannot size this ticket.
err_risk_pct: Risk per trade must be greater than 0% and at most 10%.
err_sell_flat: No long position to sell in this symbol.
err_sell_qty: Enter how many shares to sell.
err_sell_needs_mark: Need a mark to size this exit in dollars.
err_sell_notional: Enter a dollar amount greater than $0.00.
err_sell_notional_too_much: That is more than this position is worth ({value}).
err_sell_short: This symbol is held short. Manual tickets close longs only — they cannot add to a short.
err_sell_too_many: You cannot sell more shares than you hold.
err_size_zero: This ticket sizes to less than one whole share, and a protective stop needs at least one. Raise Risk per trade % or lower Stop = ATR ×.
err_size_zero_closed: Outside regular hours Alpaca needs whole shares, and this ticket sizes to less than one.
err_symbol_required: Enter a stock symbol (e.g., AAPL, MSFT).
estimate_no_atr: No ATR available — sized from the flat stop % instead of volatility.
estimate_over_bp: Estimated cost exceeds buying power — Alpaca may reject this ticket.
estimate_pending: Enter a symbol and the desk will size the ticket.
estimate_sell_note: Closes {qty} of {held} shares held. Resting protective stops are cancelled before the sell.
estimate_whole_shares: Rounded down to whole shares — a protective stop cannot attach to a fractional order.
limit_offset_hint: Limit orders rest until price trades there.
manual_help_buy: A protective stop is attached to the fill.
manual_help_limit: Limit DAY order — it rests until price trades there.
manual_help_market: Market DAY order in regular hours.
manual_help_sell: Protective stops are cancelled before a sell.
manual_risk_help_short: Shares are set so a stop-out costs your risk budget: equity × risk % ÷ (ATR × multiplier). More volatility means fewer shares for the same dollar risk.
manual_sell_flat: No long position in this symbol — nothing to sell.
manual_sell_held: You hold {held} shares. Resting protective stops are cancelled before the sell.
manual_sell_hint: Choose how much of the position to close. Any resting protective stop is cancelled first.
manual_side_help: Buy and Short open risk; Sell and Cover close the matching side of an existing position.
market_orders_rth_only: Market orders only in regular hours
order_cancelled_qty: Order canceled — qty adjustment not confirmed.
preview_order_hint: Ask the desk to size the ticket without sending it
manual_loop_locked_link: Stop the loop on Auto Trade
manual_action_busy: Wait for the current action to finish.
size_help_dollars: Shares = your dollar amount ÷ mark, rounded down. The ATR stop still sets where the trade is wrong.
size_help_shares: You choose the share count; the ATR stop still sets where the trade is wrong, so watch Max risk.
help_dollar_amount: Cash to put to work. Shares = amount ÷ mark, rounded down to whole shares.
help_sell_dollars: Shares = amount ÷ fill price (limit if set, otherwise the mark). Cannot exceed the position.
help_sell_dollars_preview: ≈ {shares} shares at {price}. Cannot exceed the position.
help_buy_shares: Exact share count. The stop still comes from ATR, so your dollar risk moves with it.
help_take_profit_r: Target distance in multiples of the stop, sent as the other leg of a bracket order. 0 sends a stop only.
bracket_help: Attach automated stop-loss and take-profit exit orders when this buy order fills.
estimate_no_bracket_offrth: Outside regular hours a bracket cannot attach — the stop is armed after the fill and no target is placed.
err_notional: Enter a dollar amount greater than $0.00.
err_buy_qty: Enter how many shares to buy.
err_risk_needs_bracket: Risk sizing requires a protective stop. Enable Protective Bracket or switch to Shares (#) or Dollars ($).
err_take_profit_r: Take profit = R × must be 20 or less.
reinvest_help: When the sell fills, the desk sends a limit buy at your price. The wait starts then; if the price does not print in time, the buy-back is cancelled.
help_reinvest_qty: Exact share count to buy back, whatever the sell fills.
help_reinvest_expire: After the sell fills, how long the buy-back may rest at your price. If it does not fill, it is cancelled. Max 1440 (24h).
reinvest_price_hint: The price the buy-back rests at once the sell fills.
reinvest_runtime_note: The wait starts after the sell fills. If the buy-back does not fill in time, it is cancelled. Waiting plans resume after a restart.
reinvest_note_above: The buy-back price is above the sell price — you would be buying the shares back for more than you sold them.
reinvest_note_runtime: The wait starts after the sell fills. If the buy-back does not fill in time, it is cancelled. Waiting plans resume after a restart.
reinvest_state_waiting: Waiting for the sell to fill
reinvest_state_placing: The sell filled — sending the buy-back…
reinvest_state_expired: Expired — the buy-back did not fill in time
err_reinvest_limit: Enter the price the buy-back should pay — it must be greater than $0.00.
err_reinvest_qty: Enter how many shares to buy back.
err_reinvest_expire: The buy-back wait must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.
followon_legend: Next ticket after this close fills
followon_help: When the close fills, the desk sends the next order at your price. Nothing is sent if the close never fills.
followon_help_reverse_sell: When the sell fills, the desk shorts this stock at your price. The whole long must close first — Alpaca will not short while you are still long.
followon_help_rotate: When the close fills, the desk sends a limit buy in a different symbol.
followon_help_reverse_sell_market: When the sell fills, the desk shorts this stock at the then-current price. The whole long must close first — Alpaca will not short while you are still long.
followon_help_rotate_market: When the close fills, the desk sends a market buy in a different symbol.
help_followon_qty: Exact share count for the next ticket, whatever the close fills.
help_followon_expire: After the close fills, how long the desk may take to send the next ticket. Max 1440 (24h).
followon_price_hint: The price the next ticket rests at once the close fills.
followon_market_hint: Fills at the then-current price once the close fills. Market tickets only send during regular hours.
followon_partial_warn: Reverse needs the whole position closed. Enter the full available quantity, or the next ticket cannot fire.
followon_runtime_note: Waiting next tickets are saved and resume after a restart until the close fills.
followon_confirm_reverse_sell_market: Short {qty} at market after the sell fills
followon_confirm_rotate_market: Buy {qty} {symbol} at market after the close fills
followon_note_runtime: The desk sends the next ticket after the close fills; waiting plans resume after a restart until the close fills.
followon_note_market: Market next tickets only send during regular hours.
followon_state_waiting: Waiting for the close to fill
followon_state_placing: The close filled — sending the next ticket…
followon_state_expired: Expired — the next ticket was not sent in time
err_followon_limit: Enter the price the next ticket should rest at — it must be greater than $0.00.
err_followon_qty: Enter how many shares the next ticket should send.
err_followon_expire: The next-ticket wait must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.
err_followon_symbol: Enter the symbol the next ticket should buy.

ai_query_placeholder: AAPL sells that lost more than 50
ai_query_help: Plain language, turned into filters the page applies to fills it already loaded.
ai_query_unsupported: That is not something this page can filter for. Try naming a symbol, a side, or a P&L threshold.
review_help: Every figure below is computed from your fills. The written summary only explains those figures — it never calculates one.
review_no_key: Add an AI provider key on Configuration to get a written review.
review_disclaimer: A read of past paper trades, not advice and not a forecast.
review_calibration_help: Win rate of closed trades grouped by the confidence the engine had when it opened them. Flat or inverted bars mean the confidence dial is not earning its keep.
review_calibration_empty: No desk entries in this range carry a confidence score yet.
review_pm_empty: No closed trades in this range yet — a post-mortem needs a buy and the sell that retired it.
review_audit_empty: Nothing to audit yet. Risk-gate blocks, skipped cycles and stop moves are recorded as the desk runs.
review_lessons_help: Saving a lesson adds it to the AI engine's playbook for future decisions. Nothing reaches the engine until you save it, and a lesson never overrides a risk rule.
review_lesson_delete_confirm: Remove this lesson from the playbook?
review_flag_small_sample: Only {count} closed trades — below {threshold} the win rate is noise, not a result.
review_flag_concentrated: One trade is {pct}% of the gross profit. Take the edge out and the range looks very different.
review_flag_losing_edge: Profit factor {value} across {count} closed trades — this set of rules lost money.
review_flag_thin_edge: Profit factor {value} across {count} closed trades — barely above break-even once costs are real.
review_flag_payoff_upside_down: Average loss ({avg_loss}) is larger than average win ({avg_win}) and most trades lose. Both dials are pointing the wrong way.
review_flag_calibration_inverted: High-confidence entries did worse than low-confidence ones across {sample} trades — the confidence dial is inverted.
review_flag_calibration_thin: Only {sample} scored entries — too few to judge whether confidence predicts anything.
review_flag_wide_spread_entries: {count} entries were opened on spreads over 20 bps ({losses} lost). The cost was in the price before the thesis had a chance.
review_flag_gates_dominant: Risk gates blocked {blocked} entries against {fills} fills — the desk is mostly refusing to trade.
review_flag_market_closed_skips: {count} cycles were skipped because the market was closed.
review_flag_unmatched_sells: {count} sells closed positions opened before this range — their P&L is not counted here.
review_flag_window_truncated: The broker window was truncated, so some fills in this range are missing from every figure above.
help_tif_day: A Day order is cancelled at the close if it has not filled.
help_tif_gtc: Good till cancelled — the order keeps resting across sessions until it fills or you cancel it.
help_tif_ioc: Immediate or cancel — whatever fills right now fills; the rest is dropped.
help_tif_fok: Fill or kill — the whole size fills at once, or nothing does.

help_tif_cls: At the close — the order only participates in the closing auction.

asset_not_tradable: Alpaca does not accept orders in this symbol — it is not tradable.
asset_not_shortable: This symbol cannot be shorted at Alpaca — the borrow is unavailable.

stop_to_trailing_hint: Replace the fixed stop with a trailing one
breakeven_needs_entry: Alpaca has no average entry price for this position
err_stop_price: Enter a stop price greater than $0.00.
manual_partial_rearm: A stop is re-armed over the shares you keep once this fills.
save_preset_hint: Save these settings as a reusable ticket preset
help_shortcuts: Shortcuts: B buy · S sell · P preview · ⌘/Ctrl+Enter place.

breach_spread: Spread {actual} bps is above the desk limit of {limit} bps.

err_buy_on_short: This symbol is held short — close it from Positions before buying.

estimate_exit_full: Closes the whole {held}-share position and cancels the resting stop with it.
estimate_total_heat: Open risk after this ticket: {pct}% of equity.
manual_side_help_buy: Buy opens or adds to a long and sizes from your risk budget.
manual_side_help_sell: Sell closes part or all of a long. A partial sell keeps a stop over what is left.
manual_help_trailing: Trailing {tif} order — the trigger follows the best price and never moves back.
manual_help_stop: {tif} order that stays dormant until price reaches the trigger.
manual_help_limit_tif: Limit {tif} order — it rests until price trades there.
reinvest_state_interrupted: The desk restarted while this was being sent — check Positions.
manual_automation_not_restored: Turned off for safety, re-enable if needed: {list}.
dip_hunt_help: When the stop fills, the desk waits for a further drop from that sell price. If the drop hits before the wait is up, it buys immediately. If the wait ends first, it parks a limit at the same target. The cycle repeats until you cancel it or the take-profit fills.
help_dip_hunt_wait: How long to watch after the stop fills before parking a limit. Skipped if the drop prints first. Max 1440 (24h).
help_dip_hunt_pct: Buy this far below the stop-out fill. Example: stop at $10, 5% → limit at $9.50.
dip_hunt_runtime_note: Live hunts are saved and resume after a restart until the re-buy fills or you cancel them.
dip_hunt_summary: After a stop-out, wait up to {wait} minutes for a further {dip}% drop — or buy immediately if that drop hits sooner. Then repeat.
dip_hunt_summary_price: Example from the mark: stop ~{stop} → buy at {buy}.
dip_hunt_confirm_value: After stop-out: wait {wait}m for a {dip}% drop, or buy immediately if it prints first
dip_hunt_state_watching_entry: Waiting for the buy to fill
dip_hunt_state_hunting_ready: Wait ended — limit parked at {price} when sent
dip_hunt_state_interrupted: The desk restarted while this was being sent — check Positions.
dip_hunt_note_runtime: After a stop-out the desk hunts a cheaper re-entry; the cycle repeats until you cancel it or the take-profit fills. Live hunts resume after a restart.
err_dip_hunt_wait: The dip-hunt wait must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.
err_dip_hunt_pct: The further drop must be greater than 0% and at most 50%.
help_stop_limit_offset: After the stop triggers, sell at a limit this % below it. 0 sells at market unless you set a sell limit.
err_stop_limit_offset: Stop-limit cushion must be between 0% and 50%.
help_stop_limit_price: Optional. Must sit at or below the stop, not above. Overrides the cushion % when set. Leave empty for market or cushion.
err_stop_limit_price: Sell limit must be greater than $0.00.
err_stop_limit_below_stop: Sell limit must be at or below the stop price.
err_no_stop_yet: Size the ticket first so the stop price is known.

cancel_all_count_at_least: At least {count} open orders will be canceled.
orders_cancelled_partial: {cancelled} canceled; {failed} could not be canceled. Refresh and review remaining orders.

auth_showcase_desc: Self-hosted, 100% free paper & live trading desk natively engineered for Alpaca Markets. Fuses multi-modal AI intelligence, 5 algorithmic strategy engines, and autonomous ATR risk guardrails.
auth_showcase_engines_sub: Switch between institutional trend-following, mean-reversion, and AI market reasoning.
auth_engine_ai_desc: Synthesizes Technical Indicators (RSI, MACD, BB, ATR, ADX), Yahoo Finance live news sentiment, Nasdaq earnings calendars, and Forex Factory macroeconomic events via GPT-4o and Gemini 2.0 into structured risk-sized orders.
auth_engine_ls_desc: Daily EMA fast/slow cross with ADX trend strength gating. Enters high-momentum swings, filters out sideways chop, and executes ATR-sized long/short legs.
auth_engine_dip_desc: Detects capitulation sell-offs and panic washouts. Enters when RSI breaches oversold thresholds and price pierces the lower Bollinger Band with dynamic recovery exit rules.
auth_engine_sma_desc: Proven trend-following moving average crossovers across your watchlist. Choose from Golden Cross (50/200), Swing (20/50), Fibonacci (8/21), Classic (10/30), or Custom.
auth_engine_pair_desc: Rotates exposure between correlated or leveraged/inverse equity pairs (e.g. QLD/QURL or TQQQ/SQQQ). Holds long leg in bull regimes and rotates to short leg on confirmed bear impulses.
auth_showcase_pillar_risk_desc: Mechanical position sizing based on equity risk percentage and ATR volatility. Automated trailing stops, take-profit scaling, spread checks, and daily drawdown circuit breakers.
auth_showcase_pillar_bt_desc: Simulate strategies against historical daily and minute bars. Compare CAGR, Sharpe Ratio, Max Drawdown, Win Rate, and Profit Factor side-by-side.
auth_showcase_pillar_desk_desc: Modern, zero-build responsive web desk with real-time portfolio telemetry, advanced order ticketing with risk guards, and cycle audit histories.
auth_free_banner_desc: AlgoPaca has zero platform fees, and Alpaca provides $0 commission stock & ETF trading. No credit card required.
